batting.name: TL Suman
batting.dismissal: c AL Menaria b SR Watson

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c SR Watson b A Singh

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c LRPL Taylor b SR Watson

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: st PR Shah b SK Warne

balls.text: Shane Warne has bowled his last ball in competitive cricket. It's a full toss on off stump and driven to long off.
yorker length and driven to mid on, the last ball is coming up

now he gets one and how wily is that? Warne tosses it up and it turns away, Sharma has come miles down the track as he looks to hit that over the Warne's head. He loses his bat in the process of trying and misses the ball, it's an easy stumping in the end. Warne has engineered this one for sure.
turned to deep square leg for one
or with the second. There's the wrong 'un and Franklin drives over the inner ring, It as in the air for a fair bit but eluded the fielder and ended up at the deep extra cover boundary

dropped  And he won't get a wicket with the first ball. Sharma gets under it and slog sweeps very high in the air. Menaria at long on was watching the ball all the way and didn't even get fingers to it.
full again and its has spoilt a really good over from Botha. Franklin drives to long off and drives well, the timing is good enough and he beats the diving fielder. One over left.
full on legstump and played to fine leg, Sharma would have wanted more from that ball
well bowled, full and straight and Sharma has to dig it out of the blockhole
stifled appeal from Botha, that was the offspinner and turning down the leg side, Sharma misses the sweep and is caught on the pads
cut through the covers just the one down there
full from Botha and Sharma doesn't get hold of it, drives in the air to long off
and too good indeed. Now he's got him. Watto goes fuller and Pollard looks to drive He gets an inside edge and drags the ball onto middle stump
now the bouncer, Pollard wants to lull but Watto is too good for him
smart from Watto, he can see Sharma backing away and he keeps it full and outside off to Sharma has to reach for it and he is just able to get it to point
short ball, pulled to deep mid wicket
too far down the leg side, Sharma thought of the pull but it was too far for him to reach
short ball and Sharma brings out the upper cut. It's a good looking shot but Trivedi is better and he slides across to cut off two
good yorker from Watson, Pollard has to get his bat down quickly to squeeze that out to third man
looks to drive and gets an outside edge to third man, keeps strike
quiet now, defended back to the bowler
goes iside out over extra cover and that has gone to the rope faster than Johan Botha at long off could blink nevermind move
he's been given a chance and he is taking it. Flat bats that past the non striker and it races to long on

Miscued from Pollard. He goes for the big hit over the covers and gets off the toe end of the bat.  That was a tough one for Ross Taylor who had to change direction while attempting to take the catch and in the end doesn't get a hand to it.
100 comes up with a casual shot to sweeper cover
swept to deep mid-wicket, on one knee, it's a good over from Warne, who is pushing the brakes on the MI innings himself
comes down the wicket and gets an under edge onto the on side
turned to mid-wicket, sensible stuff from Pollard
that's 50 for Rohit Sharma, and an innings of great maturity. Plays that out past point to bring up the half-century
half tracker and Pollard wanted to smash it, he didn't get too much on it and slapped it down to long on, he had the time to do more than that
turns away from Sharma who cuts square of the wicket
gets a big stride in and a leading edge into the covers, Warne doesn't pick up cleanly and Sharma calls for the run, he wants to keep strike
very nice from Shrama, gives himself some room and hits against the turn, its a bit short and he carves it on the off side, great timing takes it to the boundary t
pushed to mid on, Pollard happy to turn the strike and not look for anything too big
Down on one knee, swept down to long on, Sharma going for the shots now
worked into the on-side very tentative from Pollard, Sharma wants one
goes straight on and pushed to mid on
slower ball to end the over and its worked onto the on side, past mid-on and they look for two and get it
Singh giving Pollard the treatment, that's a bouncer and it follows Pollard, who ducks to avoid it
he has learnt his lesson about bowling short, pitches this one up and Sharma cant get under it properly, smacks it to long on, only for one
now Singh drops it short and Sharma loves it. He pulls with such style, uses the wrists well and sends that miles. That's a biggie
goes down the track and lofts that over long off, hasnt got enough on it and it doesnt reach the boundary, but its a good shot on the charge
well, Amit Singh, if you are going to open a door, Sharma is going to walk through it. Too much width outside off and Sharma takes full advantage, drived through point and its an easy four
full again, driven to long on this time
fuller delivery on off stump and driven to extra cover
Sharma continues to work the ball on the on side, turns it to mid-wicket but that area is protected
Pollard is off the mark with an awkward steer to short third man, he does look uncomfortable getting down and playing the ball like that
swept to deep backward square leg
down the leg side and that's called wide
turned to mid-wicket by Sharma, Botha tossing it up nicely
good bowling from Amit Singh, Bangs that in short and makes Pollard look like a scared kitten. He backs away a litlte bit, hops on his backfoot and has a very surprised look on his face.
not short enough to pull but Pollard wants to anyway and he mistimes that horribly, doesn't even make contact
but not facing, Sharma plays that down to fine leg to put the big West Indian on strike

the end of SRT. It was quicker from Singh and banged in short. SRT decided to cut. He didn't get as much as bat as he would have liked on it and it ended up being an easy catch for Shane Watson at third man. He holds on to the ball gleefully, this is a big wicket for sure.
too cute from SRT. He makes a little move across his stumps and knows there's a gap at fine leg, so he scoops the ball through there and its an easy boundary
back of a length and worked to mid on, thoughts of a run but they decide against it
driven into the covers and SRT keeps strike
slower and looks like Warney is tryng the wrong 'un. SRT defends solidly
more confident stroke this time, steered to third man where Ross Taylor has to do some work again and cut it off, he does so comfortably
mishit and lucky for SRT. Deceived by the turn and looks to play to mid-wicke but ends up hitting it over Warney's head and it's in the air for a fair while before it bounced before long off.
pushed to short cover form SRT, also wanting to counter the turn
Sharma has the dancing shoes on, comes down the track and hits the ball with the turn, drives to long off
SRT comes down the wicket and plays across the line, gets an inside edge to fine leg, good sstart from Botha
nudged through the covers
it seems that every run in this over is rushed, that's to short fine leg again and they want the run despite the man there
driven to mid on, Taylor dives to his left and saves any runs
turned to mid-wicket, its a scramble again, but the two are committed
SRT walks across and plays to short fine leg, Sharma has to hurry to make it through but he does
tossed up again and Sharma is up for it, drives through the covers and ends and expensive over for Warney. Time Out time.
a little leading edge from SRT, wide of cover, nothing too dramatic in the battle between the two big guns yet
turned to short fine leg, SRT to face again
tossed up, Sharma counters the spin by coming forward and clips to that same mid-wicket area for two more
quicker one and Sharma gets his bat down in time to dig the ball out to mid-wicket, he comes back quickly and gets the two
starts with a flighted one, pushed square on the off side for one
worked wide of mid on, that one was coming into the pads from Trivedi
super shot from SRT. Punched off the back foot past point and beats the man on the boundary who attempts a diving save
short of a length and drilled through the covers, Warne leaves it for the fielder in the deep to clean up
this one is a little short and its pulled with some power to deep mid wicket, great shot for one
here's the legcutter, slapped into the covers
turned through mid-wicket
cut to point, no run there, and ends a very good four overs from Chavan, who will may think himself very unlucky today
short and pulled. Nice positioning from Rohit who rocks on the backfoot and sends that wide of mid on
SRT is down the track and flicks to midwicket for one
driven to short cover, Warney is on the act and gets down quickly to save some runs
appeal for lbw  big shout from Chavan, its the slider and SRT looks to drags across. Seems as though it may have been missing leg but HawkEye shows that it was hitting leg stump.
slow turn again from Chavan, who is bowling his last, touch short and cut away
and a boundary comes finally. Picked up and dispatched over mid-wicket. Sharma did that with such ease and it was only just short of going all the way, bounced a touch inside.
nipping back in, Shrama gets behind the line and defends
short of a length and angling in, worked off the backfoot to mid on
drifting into the pads and turned to mid-wicket
on target, decent length and Sharma is on the drive, he gets a thick edge down to third man
short and a bit of width outside off, Rohit plays a nothing shot, flashing and hanging his bat out
best ball of the over, There is definitely turn on offer here. That went past the outside edge and some good bounce as well. SRT beaten.
still pushing it around, this time through the inner ring, to deep extra cover
just a touch short of a length and off the back foot, into the covers
gets it away this time, driven to deep extra cover where Botha has work to do again, he puts in the slide and cuts off a certain boundary
tries to cut away this time, still not able to get proper contact
driven into the covers, Chavan getting some turn

a touch slower and Rayudu tries to drive through mid off but gets a leading edge and the ball lobs up in the air, just over the inner ring. Super catch from Ross Taylor running backwards and to his left from his position in the covers.
nicely played, whipped off the toes to fine leg and Botha has to run around quickly to cut it off on the boundary, good timing on that shot
played off the backfoot to midwicket
banged in short and Rayudu pulls too early and misses
just outside off this time, Rayudu looks to steer to third man, but pushes it to slip
drifting into the pad and helped on its way to fine leg
ends the over with a fuller one, driven to long off
touch short, SRT backs away and cuts to cover
swept over the inner ring, almost goes all the way but one bounce before it hits the rope. Warney tells a story of SRT inviting him for dinner during Tests and keeping him awake until 2am
turns nicely and there's a bit of bounce, Tendulkar is beaten as he goes forward and the keeper whips off the bails, no referral
flighted and pushed to mid on for one, the commentators are trying to get Warney to sledge Sachin on air
slower through the air, nudged to square leg
pulled to midwicket, not with the same disastrous result as Suman's shot. Good over from Watto.
well bowled Watto, as Warney says. Back of a length and cuts back in sharply, Rayudu gets an inside edge onto the pads.
good length and just outsife off, Rayudu defends and Warney says "Well bowled," He says the IPl has broken down barriers in world cricket

early breakthrough for RR. That one was straighter from Watson and Suman looks to flick away through mid-wicket. He did everything right except the "through" part of the shot and fed it down Menaria's throat. Easy catch in the end and Warney could be heard on the mic saying "yeah."
just a touch outside off this time and full. Suman goes for the drive, it goes aerial over the inner ring and through the covers for four
on the legstump line and its off the pads for a leg bye to fine leg, Warney is on the mic directing some traffic
good length on middle, comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler
short of a length on the off, makes room to cut it to point
pushed away into the off side to get off the mark

appeal for lbw, landed around leg stump, turned in and struck Tendulkar on the pads when he went back to defend, looked really close, that was actually plumb as the replays confirm. Landed on leg stump and not outside as the umpire may have thought, lucky
short of a good length outside off, punched off the back foot wide of extra cover for a single

James Franklin comes into the attack and he goes out just as quickly. Dravid lofts that over deep mid-wicket, it was a tame delivery really, too short and Dravid was able to pick it up and send it for a bounce four to end the match
quicker one, played off the hips into the leg side
Malinga looks to do it again, but doesn't quite get it right, Watson drives to long off
finally, we see the Malinga yorker, toe crushing in all its glory. Well bowled and well dug out.
good length, squeezed out to the off side and they run quickly for the one. One scoring shot away now
driven along the ground this time for one
oh ho! Malinga returns only to smashed. He bowls the slower one and Watto is on it like a flash. He smashes it over long on, keeps the face of the bat nic and straight and that is huge.
that is a stunning shot for one. Driven down past Munaf, straight as a pin, there's a man there though, so it isnt a boundary but it was good looking enough to be one
pushes back to Munaf who stops it slightly on its way to long on
too short and not quick enough, Dravid pulls over backward square leg, that's exactly the kind of delivery he likes to punish
big shout for caught behind, Dravid flashed at one outside off and Munaf was quite certain that there was a nick, Dravid immediately shook his head and he was given not out
Dravid comes down the track and turns that into a length ball and drives over extra cover
Munaf is back and he offers Watto a wide one, back of a length, he thumps it to long off

Short and wide outside off, creamed through the covers from Dravid, looks like its been timed well but Rohit Sharma does well to slide and cut off four. That's probably the first bit of commitment from the Mumbai fielders we have seen.
tapped onto the leg side, ambled single taken
loosely driven to long on
too classy from Dravid, takes a step out of the crease and flicks it though fine leg to bring up the 100 in elegant fashion
Pollars stalled in his run up in the previous one, this one is bowled as it should be, driven to long on
Dravid carries on hsi main role, rotates the strike, guides this down to third man

it had to happen, didn't it? Touch shorter from Malinga, Watto gets his chance and takes it, on the pull again. Smokes it over fine leg for six more. 97 runs in 10 overs and RR are making a mockery of the Mumbai bowlers
lands it on a good length and Watto defends into the covers
now he is able to guide it third man, as he wanted to do the last ball
great ball, surprises Dravid. Back of a length, some extra bounce and Dravid is beaten
attempted yorker, but gets a full toss and Dravid clips to backward square leg
full and straight and pushed to mid on, Malinga has gone back to his basics it seems
slower ball and driven to deep point, nice bit of finesse to end the over
shimmies down the track and turns turned through backward square leg
bangs in the bouncer and Dravid moves out of the way
and the target is now less than 50. Dravid goes down the track and smokes it through the covers, it's so easy
short again and mistimed to short cover
back of a length outside off and cut to point
tossed up and driven to mid on, very expensive over from Bhajji
whipped to mid-wicket, Mumbai bleeding runs here
and the carnage continues. Habhajan keeps it quick and Watson knows there is no fine leg. Cute little shot, walks across and lifts it into that vacant fine leg area
and Watson does it again, this time he drills it to Pollard at long on and he slides in but can't get anywhere near it, egg on his face for sure
driven down to long on and all Kieron Pollard had to do was bend down and pick it up but he let it sneak in between his legs and nothing can go right for Mumbai
tossed up and whipped to mid on
down the leg side as Harbhajan starts with a wide
pushed to mid on and Watto keeps strike, Dravid has only faced 10 balls so far
and he ain't stopping now. Watson picks that up and dispatches it over long on Not the worst ball but he is going to gobble everything
50 for Shane Watson. Driven beautifully to long off, slight misfield allows for the second run and Watto has his highest score of this IPL. He is doing a terrific job
dabbed into the on side, no run there
creamed through the covers with such good timing that it reaches the rope. Watto is driving so well on the front foot and he beats the inner ring and the sweeper
full and well dug out from Dravid, drives to long on and gives Watto the strike

and still, Malinga bowls it shotrt and Watson is on the pull again. This was close to that midwicket fielder but he was probably more concerned with not being taken out than catching it and its another four. RR racing away with this
Malinga is persisting with the short ball and this one is in the slot for Watto and he pulls with great power. That's off the front foot and over midwicket.
Malinga goes for the short one again, but that is too quick, and Watson attempts to upper cut but flashes and misses
looking to work off the pads through the leg side
the short one from Malinga, climbed onto Watto quickly, but he seemed to be ready for that. Pulled through mid-wicket, doesn't get hold of it properly but it trickles away for four
Malinga continues and it's full, Dravid just steers it to third man, he knows his role is to put Watto on strike
full and nicely driven, with  the full face of the bat presented dead straight, finds mid off
run down to third man and it's a scramble for the second  but Watson wants it

dabbed to the right of the bowler and Dravid is off immediately, he is halfway down the track before Watto has even seen him. Harbhajan comes in from mid-on and wants to smash in into the stumps but throws too hard and misses. Run-out opportunity missed and less than 100 needed
outside off and pushed into the covers
whipped through midwicket, that's on the pads and Watto can take advantage, there is a fielder in the deep, so its just the one
angling in and worked through the on side, through mid-wicket

short and Watto is ready for it this time. He pulls, doesn't get as much bat as he would've liked to but he has cleared the inner ring and there is a big gap down to deep mid-wicket. Finishes with a four.
short of a length, keeps Watto defending on the back foot, a little hop and a jump as he dabs it into the off side
ouch! Good respinder from Malinga, bangs it in short and pings Watto on the neck, that has to be sore
fuller and slower from Malinga and Watto drills it past the Sri Lankkan to long off. Not a lot of foot movement there, just stand and deliver stuff
back of a length and defended on the off side
perfect start, good length on middle and pushed out to point
back of a length, some bounce on offer and steered down to third man
driven again this time with a litle less force and there's no run
driven out to mid-off where SRT does the fielding and there's an enormous roar for th most popular man in Mumbai
Dravid gets an inside edge onto the pads and there is a stifled shout for lbw. A shy at the stumps results in the one run
Watto uses the full face of the bat to guide this one to third man
Dravid looking to drive and gets an outside edge to third man
tossed up, pushed to point
big again, even bigger than the other one, that's short on middle and Watto slams it over mid-wicket, not caught this time.
flatter on leg stump and Watto is hit on the pads, big appeal for lbw but its going past leg
that is big. Watson takes it from outside off stump and smashes it over long on, where someone in the crowd takes a good catch.
angles into Watson again and he pushes to mid on
spins into Watson, turned around to short fine leg
but of frustrating creeping in, perhaps. Dravid flashes and misses, Munaf ends it well
now he's getting it, persisting with that back of a length line and Dravid pushes it into the covers
back of a length again and chopped down to third man by Watson
short of a length and pushed to third ma, Dravid takes the bottom hand off the handle as he plays that
better now, outside off and steered away down to third man, the cameras show us Malinga wearing a purple floppy instead of the cap
that's not much better, Munaf strays on the pads, Watson only has to help it on its way to fine leg, not controlled from Munaf
doesn't start well, bangs it in fairly short and down the leg side, called wide
